extracted.intended_audience: journalism students, early-career reporters, and practitioners updating skills for online/social news
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for producing clear, accurate, attention‑grabbing news copy across print and online platforms, covering news judgment, reporting, structure, style and presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundamental skill: hone and craft an eye catching news story
rubrics_metrics.description: The ability to hone and craft an eye catching news story is fundamental to good journalism. It is an essential skill that all journalists must carry with them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises producing stories that attract and hold reader attention; page offers this as the central organising principle for the book but does not list detailed subcriteria on the item page.

rubrics_metrics.name: What makes news?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chapter title indicating criteria for newsworthiness (news values such as timeliness, impact, novelty, prominence, etc. are likely discussed in the book). No further detail on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: The inverted pyramid
